messages.subject: time gaps in camera trap effort in SCR
parts:
Hi team,

I have a methodological question that I would like to share with you. I am running a SCR model for leopards. My dataset is divided into three areas inside my study area: East, West and Central.
East was surveyed in 2021 and early 2022, and West and central was surveyed in 2023 with almost a year of gap between East and West/central.
My question is, Is it possible to cluster areas that are separated in time? for example my East and central subgroups? or the three of them together? I tried to do it but the models secr.fit() wil not run with the time discontinuity. 


I would like to read your thoughts about any alternative. Or if there is not I will keep with my current clustering by survey effort.

Thank you in advance

messages.subject: RE: time gaps in camera trap effort in SCR
parts:
Dear Antonio,

 

Of course you can do it. It is a multi-session SCR approach. Here you can find an example:  https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-023-31105-w, but sure in SCR Google Group https://groups.google.com/g/spatialcapturerecapture you’ll can find more information.

 

Good luck!

José Jiménez
